thesis: Tesla, Inc. (TSLA) zatvorila je na 370,59 USD (+4,65%), uz tržišnu kapitalizaciju od oko 1.464 milijarde USD, što je i dalje znatno ispod 52-sedmičnog maksimuma od 498,83 USD [1]. Fundamenti ne prate ovu valuaciju: prihod u 2025. pao je na 94,83 milijarde USD (−2,93% međugodišnje), a neto dobit na 3,79 milijardi USD u odnosu na 7,13 milijardi USD u 2024., uz neto maržu od samo 4% i operativnu maržu od 1,41% [1]. Uz P/E od 343,14 i forward P/E od 172,79, cijena se zasniva na očekivanjima budućeg rasta, a ne na trenutnoj profitabilnosti, iako slobodni novčani tok od 6,22 milijarde USD u 2025. i nizak omjer duga i kapitala (0,18) daju određenu finansijsku stabilnost [1]. Ključni rizici za tezu rasta su moguća kašnjenja u razvoju i povećanju proizvodnje, nemogućnost kontrole proizvodnih troškova i potreba da kompanija značajno poveća pristup baterijskim ćelijama, uključujući i vlastitu proizvodnju [2].

risks.text: We may experience issues or delays in developing, launching and ramping the production of our products, services and features, or we may be unable to control our manufacturing costs.
Our suppliers may fail to deliver components according to schedules, prices, quality and volumes that are acceptable to us, or we may be unable to manage these components effectively.

We may be unable to meet our projected construction timelines, costs and production ramps at new factories, or we may experience difficulties in generating and maintaining demand for products manufactured there and related services.

We may be unable to grow our global product sales, delivery and installation capabilities and our servicing and vehicle charging networks, or we may be unable to accurately project and effectively manage our growth.
We will need to maintain and significantly grow our access to battery cells, including through the development and manufacture of our own cells, and control our related costs.
